[NLFC.3.2] Integration patterns:

| Pattern | Pump call site |
|---|---|
| Single-threaded async loop (asyncio, tokio, libuv, an event loop) | A periodic timer plus event-driven nudges when new facts arrive. |
| Dedicated worker thread | A loop calling `ds_engine_pump` until shutdown; the integrator owns the thread. |
| Thread pool, one engine per worker | Fine — each engine is independent, no cross-engine state. |
| CLI / one-shot | Set up, assert inputs, single pump, read results, free. |
